pages.text: The sky is not empty. Storms and lightning push ships, pillager airships hunt them, and whales drift above the oceans. All of it comes from add-ons that need Aeronautics.

Winds & Weather adds weather regions with storms and lightning that can strike a ship. Wind is stronger over open ocean and grows with altitude, and extreme wind pushes ships hard. Check your wind with an Anemometer.
pages.title: Weather

pages.text: Create Hostile Skies sends pillager airships after you, in tiers: Scout, Patrol, Warship, Flagship. Higher tiers open as you kill captains. Here they are rarer: an attempt every 25 minutes, starting at 5% chance. Bad Omen raises crew and loot. Ships can be captured.
pages.title: Hostile Skies
Captain's Orders
pages.text: One of two Hostile Skies items, with the Peace Treaty. They have no crafting recipe in the pack; read the tooltip.

Rare sky whales drift high over oceans. A dead one leaves a slowly sinking corpse of whale bone and meat blocks that behave as physics objects. Crushing bone gives Whale Bone Dust, which becomes End Stone Powder or, mixed, Levitite Blend.
pages.title: Sky Whales
Whale Bone Dust
pages.text: Crush or mill whale bone. Heated mixing with zinc nuggets and water makes Levitite Blend, bypassing the End.

pages.title: Cooked Whale Meat
pages.text: Raw whale meat can be cooked into food.
